newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - WASHINGTON POST BUSINESS - AUG 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - WASHINGTON POST BUSINESS - AUG 12.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Aug. 12:
WASHINGTON - In its second week, the Teamsters strike at UPS starts to hurt as firms cite difficulty in finding alternatives.
WASHINGTON - Labor Secretary Alexis Herman met with both sides separately in the eight-day-old Teamsters strike against UPS in an effort to restart negotiations.
WASHINGTON - Metrocall Inc. of Alexandria has reached a deal to buy a large Dallas-based competitor, ProNet Inc.
WASHINGTON - International donors pledged $16 billion in loans to Thailand to help it through a financial crisis -- with the United States conspicuous by its absence.
